name: Amai Miruku
source:
A friendly, bright but somewhat spoiled girl. Her family owns a farm over on Motojima, and they make most of their money from their exceptionally delicious milk.

Thus, she's very good at milking. Using her skilled fingers, she can squeeze white stuff out very well. Has a bit of a complex about the way her name is spelled. (The kanji for her name is "美乳", meaning "beautiful milk.")

She's somewhat simple-minded and easy to get worked up. Rin likes to bully her because of this.

[translated from Getchu]
